title: Chapter 124 Cao Has Something To Say
content:
Chapter 124 Cao Has Something To Say

He then opened the [chat channel].

He wanted to take advantage of this popularity to recruit some people.

As the system announcement sounded, naturally countless players filled the chat channel.

"I'm from Tianba Village, we're on the list, yay!"

"Is Lord Wang Shuo here? I want to curry your favor, please reply."

"There are people pretending to be Wang Shuo everywhere, I don't know who is the real one."

"Upstairs, don't you know how to check the player's avatar? [Disdain]"

"Hey, didn't you check the channel? They have already started saying that they are Wang Shuo's affiliated village, younger brother and other names, it's hard to tell the real from the fake!"

"Can't you just find Wang Shuo himself?"

"I added him, but he didn't agree!"

"Mine didn't agree either."

"+1"

"Wang Shuo, I advise you not to be ungrateful, otherwise, I will kowtow to you from a distance."

...

After seeing this message, Wang Shuo felt like he had missed out on hundreds of millions.

It turned out that his friend adding function had been set to prohibit adding friends.

The main reason was that in the previous battle, countless people added him as a friend. He had no time to take care of this matter, so he simply turned off this function.

After the battle, he forgot about it again.

"I am Wang Shuo, a unified reply, my territory is 50 miles north of Nanshanji, I have no affiliated villages, and no younger brothers are recruiting people in the channel, everyone don't be fooled."

"Fuck, I actually saw Wang Shuo in the channel and sent a message, I am not blind!?"

"Wang Shuo, I want to come to you, I am only 16 years old, do you want to?"

"I will bring my aunt with me, she is 32 years old, just married for 2 years, and has no children."

"Brother, please stay, I Cao has something to say."

...

Wang Shuo saw these messages and didn't know whether to laugh or cry for a while.

"Wana Village welcomes every compatriot from Blue Star to build Wana Village together. But friends come with good meat, enemies come with spears."

At this time, the system announcement sounded again.

[Fengze Village was the first to upgrade to a level 2 village, hereby announced. 】

"Oh my god, you're so fast!"

Wang Shuo is now seriously short of people. He has no choice but to watch others upgrade first.

Let's clean up his own mess first!

Three hours later, Duan Wenxi walked up to Wang Shuo.

"Boss, we have cleared all the beasts in the territory. We are dealing with the edible beasts as soon as possible. We have also stored the inedible ones that can be decomposed."

"Well, very good."

Duan Wenxi suddenly smiled mysteriously and said, "Boss, do you know how many energy crystals we have harvested this time?"

"At least a few million, right?" Wang Shuo was a little unsure, after all, the last explosion directly cleared a large area of beast corpses.

Nothing was left.

"A total of 6 million." Duan Wenxi opened his mouth exaggeratedly, "and there are all kinds of messy things, all in it."

After speaking, Duan Wenxi took out more than a dozen backpacks and handed them to Wang Shuo.

After Wang Shuo counted them one by one, his expression became unnatural.

Because the things inside are really amazing.

120 soul crystals, 90 construction acceleration scrolls, 170 growth acceleration scrolls, and hundreds of various sophisticated weapons and armors.

In this way, there is no need to forge them in the blacksmith shop.

Just when Wang Shuo took out an energy converter.

The system prompt sounded.

[It is detected that the player has 2 energy converters, which can be synthesized into a level 2 energy converter. Do you want to synthesize? ]

"Yes."

[Level 2 energy converter +1, has been placed in the core of the territory. ]

Level 2 energy converter is a necessary condition for upgrading the level 2 village, and now it is one step closer.

Then, he found another gold equipment.
